name: Coupon Plugin Lite
author: Vicky Kumar

sections.description:
Coupon Plugin is a lightweight, SEO-friendly way to publish coupon codes and deals on your WordPress site. Create attractive, fully responsive coupon boxes, add your affiliate links, and list them anywhere with a simple shortcode — no coding required.

Whether you run a dedicated coupon website, a deals blog, or a niche affiliate site, Coupon Plugin gives you a clean, conversion-focused way to present offers that your visitors actually click.

Why choose Coupon Plugin?

  • Responsive by default — coupon boxes look great on phones, tablets, and desktops.
  • Built for affiliates — add affiliate links and track the offers your readers love.
  • SEO-friendly — clean, lightweight markup that search engines can read.
  • Easy to use — list coupons with a shortcode.
  • Lightweight — no bloat and no slowdown for your site.

Coupon Plugin Lite features (free)

  • 100% responsive, attractive coupon design for every device
  • Hide-coupon functionality to reveal deals on click
  • Store image support to display brand and store logos
  • Coupon expiry date and time to manage deal validity
  • Built-in affiliate link system for monetization
  • Stylish popular-coupon strip to highlight trending deals
  • List coupons anywhere with a shortcode
  • Organize coupons by store or category

Coupon Plugin Pro features

Upgrade to Coupon Plugin Pro to unlock:

  • List coupons by category with a shortcode
  • List coupons by store with a shortcode
  • Affiliate link cloaking for cleaner, trackable links
  • Coupon voting so users can rate the best deals
  • Coupon sharing on social media (Facebook & Twitter)
  • Coupon popups for promotions and timed offers
  • Click-to-copy coupon codes for a frictionless experience
  • Grid-look shortcode for a structured coupon layout
  • Insert shortcodes directly from the editor

Perfect for

  • Affiliate marketers promoting discount codes
  • Bloggers monetizing content with deals
  • Coupon and deal websites
  • Store and brand-specific offer pages

Running a coupon or affiliate marketing site on WordPress has never been easier. Coupon Plugin helps you build attractive, responsive coupon boxes that improve the user experience and drive more affiliate sales.

Privacy

The Go Pro discount form on the plugin settings page can send the submitted name and email address to https://wpcouponplugin.com/wp-json/subscribe/v1/new. This request is only made after the administrator explicitly checks the consent checkbox and submits the form.

Source Code

The JavaScript and CSS files in assets/ are minified build output. The human-readable, non-minified sources ship with the plugin in the resources/ directory, and the build is run with npm run build (see README.md for the full build instructions).
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Coupon Plugin.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin and unzip the coupon-lite.zip file.
  2. Upload the folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in your WordPress dashboard.

After activating, open the new Coupon menu to add your first coupon, then place it on any page or post with a shortcode.
sections.faq:
Is Coupon Plugin free?

Yes. Coupon Plugin Lite is completely free. A Pro version is available with extra display options and tools such as click-to-copy, coupon popups, and category/store shortcodes.

How do I display coupons on my site?

Add coupons from the Coupon menu, then show them with a shortcode anywhere on your site.

Can I add affiliate links to my coupons?

Yes. Each coupon supports an affiliate link, so you can monetize your deals and send visitors straight to the offer.

Will it work with my theme?

Coupon Plugin uses clean, responsive markup that works with virtually any modern WordPress theme, on any screen size.

Is the plugin SEO-friendly?

Yes. Coupon boxes are built with lightweight, semantic markup so they stay fast and search-engine friendly.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. Coupon Plugin is lightweight and only loads what it needs on pages where coupons are shown.

What is the difference between Lite and Pro?

Lite covers everything you need to create and display coupons. Pro adds conversion tools like click-to-copy codes, coupon popups, voting, social sharing, affiliate link cloaking, and category/store shortcodes. See the feature list above or visit wpcouponplugin.com.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • Redesigned the settings and Go Pro admin screens using native WordPress styles
  • Replaced bundled datetime and color picker controls with native WordPress component controls
  • Added build tooling for minified assets and publishable release output
  • Added an explicit consent step before the Go Pro discount form contacts wpcouponplugin.com
  • Improved accessibility and form labelling on the settings page
  • Coupon expiry dates are now interpreted in the site timezone instead of UTC. If your site timezone is not UTC, coupons very close to their expiry may expire at a slightly different moment after this update.

1.2.3

  • WordPress 7 compatibility updates
  • Improved settings sanitization and output escaping
